info.name: RealEstate API - Auth + Properties
info.description:
Real-estate backend API collection

## Roles
Allowed `role` values: `user`, `owner`, `admin`. Admin access: `role=admin` **or** `is_admin=true` on the user.

## Base URL
Set `{{base_url}}` (example: `https://vibesapp.digital4design.com/ontheway` or `http://localhost:3000`).

## Auth
Most requests use Bearer `{{jwt_token}}`.

## Property responses (list / show / map / favorites / admin)
- `images`: `[{ "id": "uuid", "url": "..." }]` — use `id` for `DELETE .../images/:image_id`
- `video`, `video_projection` (`flat` | `equirectangular`), `view_360_url` / `immersive_video_view_url` (WebView URL when video is present), `has_360_view` (true when equirectangular + video present)
- `features`: boolean values (e.g. `balcony: true`)
- `is_favorited`: when logged in

## Favorites
`GET /favorites` returns `{ id, created_at, property: { ...full property + type } }`.

## Main resources
- Auth (OTP)
- Profile
- Properties (CRUD + media + approval + lifecycle + 360° video metadata)
- Favorites
- Viewings (appointments)
- Maps (properties only)
- Admin (users, properties)
